Sorry, Galette. I meant to eat with everyone, but something urgent came up.
That's all right. You're welcome at the Snowflower Inn anytime.
strings.대륙의 최고인 초인들을 모셔서 정말 영광이었습니다. 다들 속이 허전하시다: It was a true honor to host the Champions, the finest on the continent. They all said they felt empty inside, and ate and drank without stopping.
strings.창고에 있던 음식 재료들이 눈 녹듯 사라질 정도니. 아, 제가 말실수를: The ingredients in our storeroom vanished like melting snow. Oh, that was a poor choice of words.
strings.게르다 사람인데, 눈이 녹는다고 하다니. 이오 님이 들으셨으면 잔뜩 혼을: A resident of Gerda talking about snow melting! Io would give me quite a scolding if she heard.
strings.발드릭 님이야 워낙 잘 드시긴 하지만, 다른 분들도 그렇게 잘 드실 줄: I know Lord Valdrick has a healthy appetite, but I never knew the others did too. I lost count of how many kegs he and Lord Ziskad emptied...
strings.…두 분 취해서 대련 같은 건 하지 않았겠죠?: ...They didn't get drunk and start sparring, did they?
strings.이오 님께서 미리 말씀하셔서 그런 일은 일어나지 않았습니다. 내가 너네들: Io warned them beforehand, so nothing of the sort happened. 'I'll freeze you all to death! Ahahaha!' was how she put it.
strings.샤이닉 님도, 이오 님도, 메디아 님도 정말 대단하셨죠. 아드키나 님께서: Lady Shynic, Io, and Lady Medea were remarkable too. And I was delighted by how much Lord Atkina enjoyed the food.
Don't worry. There's still food left for you, Adventurer.
strings.고마워요, 갈렛. 그런데 다들 돌아가신 건가요?: Thank you, Galette. Has everyone gone home?
strings.네, 이제 배가 찬다고 하시면서 다들 게르다를 떠나셨죠. 아, 렌 양은: Yes. They all said they were finally full and left Gerda. Oh, Miss Ren stayed to help out. I think she's out with Frozen at the moment...
strings.마들린, 언제 왔어?: Madeleine, when did you get here?
strings.무슨 일로 왔어? 배고파? 식사 하고 갈래?: What brings you here? Hungry? Would you like a meal?
strings.아무것도 아냐. 나 바로 갈 거야. 그건 그렇고 갈렛은 편하겠어. 알아서: Nothing. I'm leaving right away. Must be nice for you, Galette, having someone volunteer to help.
Adventurer, thank you for resolving the trouble in Eastland. Thanks to you...
Oh, I didn't do it alone.
strings.아, 맞다. 많은 분들이 모험가님을 만나면 전해 달라고 하셨어요. 기다리: Oh, right. Quite a few people asked me to pass on a message if I saw you. They'll be waiting, so enjoy a good meal at the Snowflower Inn first.
strings.많은 분들요? 초인들?: Quite a few people? The Champions?
strings.네, 초인들도 있고, 프로즌 님도 계시고, 렌 양인가 하는 수도사님도 계: Yes, the Champions, Frozen, and that monk who's apparently called Miss Ren...
strings.저는 말씀을 전했으니 가볼게요. 설원에 빙달들이 얼린 정어리로 눈싸움을: I've delivered the message, so I'll be going. The Ice Otters are having a snowball fight with frozen sardines. I'd better stop them.
strings.(갈렛이 마들린을 배웅하던 모험가에게서 반가운 소리가 들려오자 환하게 미: (As the adventurer sees Madeleine off, Galette hears a welcome sound and breaks into a bright smile.)
strings.훗, 제가 나설 차례가 됐군요!: Heh. My turn to step in!
Ahaha. I must be really hungry.
strings.잠깐만 기다려주세요. 금방 맛있는 음식이 나올 거예요!: Just a moment, please. Something delicious will be right out!
strings.(…무슨 일일까? 한번 가봐야겠네….): (...I wonder what they want. I'd better go see them...)
